about: FR-20.39: the public halves of global's identity keys (base64 SPKI DER, Ed25519), built into every package. A master accepts a 'Sign in with LGR' assertion signed by one of these and nothing else; a key is added or retired only through a release. The private half of the newest is IDP_SIGNING_KEY, sealed in lgr-secret. Separate from the licence keys on purpose: an assertion must never pass for a licence, nor the reverse.
